newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-TELFER CONFIRMED FOR LIONS COACHING ROLE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TELFER CONFIRMED FOR LIONS COACHING ROLE.

text.p: Scotland's Jim Telfer was officially confirmed on Thursday as assistant coach for the British Lions tour to South Africa next year.
Telfer, who has put on hold his role as Scotland team manager for a year, will act as assistant to Ian McGeechan. The pair last worked together when Scotland won the Five Nations grand slam in 1990.
The tour party will be announced towards the end of March.
